channel.title: Ebenezer Tarubinga: papers
channel.description: Papers by Ebenezer Tarubinga on semi-supervised semantic segmentation, each dated by its first posting on arXiv.

item.title: CW-BASS v2: Saturation-Aware Pseudo-Label Selection for Semi-Supervised Segmentation under Foundation-Model Teachers
item.description: A foundation-model teacher's confidence saturates, so a one-pass gate asks whether its confident set deserves the confidence it demands. arXiv preprint · 2026

item.title: PixCon: Clean-Positive Contrastive Learning for Foundation-Model Semi-Supervised Segmentation
item.description: A pixel memory that admits only labeled pixels, keeping contrastive positives free of pseudo-label noise, with nothing added at inference. Under review · WACV 2027

item.title: FARCLUSS: Fuzzy Adaptive Rebalancing & Contrastive Uncertainty Learning for Semi-Supervised Segmentation
item.description: Fuzzy top-K pseudo-labels with entropy-normalized uncertainty weighting: the pixels the model is least sure about are down-weighted, not discarded. Neural Networks 205

item.title: CW-BASS: Confidence-Weighted Boundary-Aware Learning for Semi-Supervised Semantic Segmentation
item.description: Confidence-weighted cross-entropy with Sobel boundary regularization, against two failures that compound: boundary blur and confirmation bias. IEEE IJCNN 2025
